abilities.effect: The cart explodes in a 40-foot radius, dealing 10d6 fire damage and 10d6 piercing damage to all creatures within the area (DC 36 basic Reflex save). Creatures who fail their save against this effect are also covered in “noodles” of tar and other sticky alchemical substances that make the creature clumsy 2 until they spend at least an hour scrubbing the noodles off.
abilities.name: Death by Noodles
abilities.trigger: The cart is moved, damaged, or physically searched

hazard.description: A seemingly innocent ramen cart is rigged to detonate if moved from its current location.
hazard.disable: Thievery DC 40 (master) to disable the detonation trigger
hazard.name: Rigged Ramen Cart

traits.text:
Alchemical items are powered by reactions of alchemical reagents. Unless otherwise noted, alchemical items aren’t magical and don’t radiate a magical aura.  
  
Alchemical creatures are partially powered by alchemical reactions.
